# Sensoria

> Sensoria is virtual 1:1 somatic sex and intimacy coaching with Claire, for individuals, couples, polycules, and all non-traditional relationship structures. Specialties: kink and BDSM, polyamory and non-monogamy, and sexual function and pleasure. Coaching, not therapy: no diagnosis or medical advice.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.sensoriacoaching.com/): overview, who it's for, the process, testimonials, and FAQ
- [About Claire](https://www.sensoriacoaching.com/about): Claire's story, approach (somatic, attachment-focused, experiential), and training, including a graduate Certificate in Sex Therapy from Antioch University Seattle and 12+ years of lived experience in kink, polyamory, and non-monogamy
- [Coaching](https://www.sensoriacoaching.com/coaching): what sex and intimacy coaching is, what we work on, and what a 75-minute virtual session looks like
- [Pricing](https://www.sensoriacoaching.com/pricing): Single Session $310; The Arc $1,710 (six sessions over about three months); Ongoing Mentorship $825/month (three sessions per month, three-month minimum). Sliding scale and scholarship spots available. Free 20-minute discovery call.
